questions.q: On conversion into shares, the entry:
o: Records a gain equal to the liability derecognised less shares
Debits the liability at carrying amount, credits share capital + premium; no P&L
Reverses the equity component to P&L
questions.why: Conversion is an equity-for-equity-for-liability internal move: no gain/loss (Ind AS 32/109 derecognition is not a P&L event for the issuer's own equity instrument).

questions.q: A corporate bond is held under a business model to collect contractual cash flows. Its terms give rise, on specified dates, to interest on the principal outstanding PLUS a modest prepayment penalty reflecting remaining interest compensation. Classification is:
o: FVTPL mandatorily due to the prepayment feature
Amortised cost — the prepayment is consistent with SPPI
questions.why: SPPI is met even with prepayment features where the prepayment substantially represents unpaid principal and interest (with reasonable additional compensation); combined with the hold-to-collect model ⇒ amortised cost.
questions.trend: Known trap zone: ICAI objective papers repeatedly test limits/exceptions of this rule (pattern estimate).
questions.probWhy: HIGH likelihood for Nov 2026 — SPPI-prepayment nuance separates strong candidates Prediction is study guidance, not an ICAI statement.

mem.tip: SPPI test: prepay fine if it's (nearly) principal + interest + reasonable break fee. Model decides SPPI-passer's destination.
mem.link: Ch 9

questions.q: A financial liability's terms are modified such that the discounted present value of the new cash flows differs from the original liability's remaining PV by 15%. The borrower should:
o: Continue with the same liability, adjust effective interest
Derecognise the original liability and recognise the new one at fair value, taking the difference to P&L
questions.why: The 10% 'substantially different' test: a modification of at least 10% PV of remaining cash flows ⇒ original liability derecognised, new liability recognised, difference to profit or loss (Ind AS 109).
questions.trend: Known trap zone: ICAI objective papers repeatedly test limits/exceptions of this rule (pattern estimate).
questions.probWhy: Realistic likelihood for Nov 2026 — 10% threshold arithmetic is an MCQ regular AI prediction, not a certainty.

mem.tip: 10% rule for both assets and liabilities derecognition: <10% tweak it; ≥10% replace it. Difference goes to P&L — not OCI.
mem.link: Ch 9

questions.q: Under the simplified approach of Ind AS 109, impairment for trade receivables without a significant financing component is measured as:
o: Lifetime expected credit losses at all times
Lifetime ECL unless credit risk has increased significantly since initial recognition
questions.why: The simplified approach permits/requires (for the mandated scope including such trade receivables) lifetime ECL at all times — no 3-stage general model.
questions.trend: Core concept that appears in some avatar in most attempts under the new scheme (pattern estimate).
questions.probWhy: Realistic likelihood for Nov 2026 — simplified-vs-general model choice is repeatedly tested AI prediction, not a certainty.

mem.ti: TI: Ind AS 109 — expected credit loss
mem.tip: Trade receivables & contract assets (no SFC) ⇒ simplified: lifetime ECL, skip stage-2 detective work. Financing component? General model returns.
mem.link: Ch 9

questions.q: A convertible bond is split under Ind AS 32. The equity component equals:
o: Fair value of the whole instrument
Proceeds less the fair value of the debt component at a market rate for non-convertible debt
questions.why: Top-down split: measure the LIABILITY first as the PV of contractual cash flows discounted at the market rate for plain-vanilla debt; residual proceeds go to equity (no re-measurement).
questions.trend: Core concept that appears in some avatar in most attempts under the new scheme (pattern estimate).
questions.probWhy: Realistic likelihood for Nov 2026 — the residual-claim logic recurs in Section B AI prediction, not a certainty.

mem.tip: Debt measured first, equity is the leftover — an inheritance, not an appraisal. Residual = equity, always.
mem.link: Ch 9

questions.q: In a qualifying fair value hedge of a fixed-rate debt instrument, the gain/loss on the hedging instrument and the loss/gain on the hedged item attributable to the hedged risk are recognised:
o: Instrument in P&L; hedged item in OCI
questions.why: Fair-value hedge: both the hedging instrument and the adjustment to the hedged item (for the hedged risk) go to P&L — they offset there. Cash flow hedges put the effective portion in OCI.
questions.trend: Core concept that appears in some avatar in most attempts under the new scheme (pattern estimate).
questions.probWhy: Realistic likelihood for Nov 2026 — the P&L-vs-OCI split across hedge types is a standing MCQ AI prediction, not a certainty.

mem.ti: TI: Hedge accounting — fair value hedge
mem.tip: FV hedge → both P&L (they kiss immediately); CF hedge → effective in OCI, wait for the forecast; net investment → OCI too.
mem.link: Ch 9

questions.q: Transferring a financial asset with full retention of prepayment risk and default risk means:
o: Continue to recognise to the extent of continuing involvement
questions.why: Derecognition is governed by transfer of risks & rewards plus control. Substantially all risks retained ⇒ continue recognition (gain/loss not booked). 'Extent of continuing involvement' applies when neither retains nor transfers substantially all.
questions.trend: Core concept that appears in some avatar in most attempts under the new scheme (pattern estimate).
questions.probWhy: Lower likelihood but possible — the three-lane derecognition test recurs as a quickie Included so a low-probability surprise cannot catch you cold.

mem.tip: Full risk ride ⇒ full recognition; half-way ⇒ involvement-limited; all gone ⇒ off the books, gain booked.
mem.link: Ch 9

questions.q: For cash-settled share-based payments (e.g., cash appreciation rights), Ind AS 102 requires:
o: Remeasure the liability at each reporting date and at settlement, with changes in P&L
questions.why: Cash-settled SBP = liability: fair value at each reporting date and settlement, movements to P&L; expense spread over vesting using expected number vesting.
questions.trend: Core concept that appears in some avatar in most attempts under the new scheme (pattern estimate).
questions.probWhy: Realistic likelihood for Nov 2026 — the equity-vs-liability measurement split is evergreen AI prediction, not a certainty.

mem.tip: Cash out at settlement ⇒ mark to market yearly. Equity at settlement ⇒ freeze at grant. The settlement currency picks the model.
mem.link: Ch 9

questions.q: A debt instrument measured at FVOCI under the hold-and-sell model is impaired by:
o: Reducing the asset in the balance sheet with a P&L charge
Recognising the loss allowance in OCI while the carrying amount in the balance sheet remains at fair value
Writing off against equity reserves only
questions.why: FVOCI debt: impairment recognised in OCI (accumulated in equity) and reduces OCI carrying, with NO reduction of the balance-sheet carrying amount (it's already at FV) — P&L charge arises and reclassification adjustment occurs.
questions.trend: Known trap zone: ICAI objective papers repeatedly test limits/exceptions of this rule (pattern estimate).
questions.probWhy: Realistic likelihood for Nov 2026 — the OCI-loss-allowance mechanic is the exact discriminator AI prediction, not a certainty.

mem.tip: Debt at FVOCI: impairment hits P&L and OCI allowance; the B/S stays at fair value. The ledger holds two books in one.
mem.link: Ch 9

questions.q: When a hold-to-collect model is changed so that a debt instrument moves from amortised cost to FVOCI, the reclassification is:
o: Prospective at fair value with prior OCI unaffected
At carrying amount, OCI recycled immediately
questions.why: Business-model changes (rare, significant & determinable by external parties) cause PROSPECTIVE reclassification at fair value on the change date; prior OCI/impairment not adjusted.
questions.trend: No dominant past-pattern signal; included for balanced coverage (AI judgement).
questions.probWhy: Lower likelihood but possible — the 'rare & prospective' pair is a known trap Included so a low-probability surprise cannot catch you cold.

mem.tip: Model changes are rare, external and prospective — fair value on the switching day, no time travel.
mem.link: Ch 9

questions.q: A structured note whose return equals 3× the movement in an equity index passes SPPI.
o: False — leveraged equity exposure fails SPPI ⇒ FVTPL
questions.why: Leverage and non-loan risk exposures (equity multiples) fail the 'solely payments of principal and interest' test — mandatory FVTPL.
questions.trend: No dominant past-pattern signal; included for balanced coverage (AI judgement).
questions.probWhy: Lower likelihood but possible — the SPPI fail-list is the heart of 109 MCQs Included so a low-probability surprise cannot catch you cold.

mem.tip: Multiply the index and you've multiplied risk away from a loan — SPPI dies, FVTPL applies.
mem.link: Ch 9

questions.q: A financial liability is derecognised when:
questions.why: Extinguishment test: the obligation is discharged, cancelled or expired. (Old-vs-new substantially-different 10% test decides whether the modification is an extinguishment.)
questions.trend: No dominant past-pattern signal; included for balanced coverage (AI judgement).
questions.probWhy: Lower likelihood but possible — definition-level with the 10% cousin Included so a low-probability surprise cannot catch you cold.

mem.ti: TI: Ind AS 109 — derecognition of liability
mem.tip: Liabilities die by discharge, cancellation or expiry — a new face at 10%+ PV difference is a resurrection.
mem.link: Ch 9

questions.q: Measurement of expected credit losses must reflect:
o: The single most likely outcome only
An unbiased, probability-weighted amount considering reasonable and supportable forward-looking info
questions.why: ECL is probability-weighted over possible outcomes with time value and supportable forward-looking estimates — not worst- or best-case.
questions.trend: Core concept that appears in some avatar in most attempts under the new scheme (pattern estimate).
questions.probWhy: Realistic likelihood for Nov 2026 — the three ingredients (unbiased weighting, TVM, forecasts) definition AI prediction, not a certainty.

mem.tip: Weight every scenario you can support, discount it, and keep your hopes out of the model.
mem.link: Chapter 9 — Accounting and Reporting of Financial Instruments

questions.q: Which instrument is classified as EQUITY under Ind AS 32?
o: Non-redeemable preference shares with discretionary dividends
Mandatorily redeemable share at fixed date
questions.why: Equity = residual after liabilities; a fixed-date redemption or issuer's obligation to pay cash creates a liability — discretionary dividends + no obligation = equity.
questions.trend: Known trap zone: ICAI objective papers repeatedly test limits/exceptions of this rule (pattern estimate).
questions.probWhy: Realistic likelihood for Nov 2026 — the obligation-vs-discretion test drives everything AI prediction, not a certainty.

mem.tip: The issuer's duty defines the label: must pay ⇒ liability; may decide ⇒ equity.
mem.link: Chapter 9 — Accounting and Reporting of Financial Instruments

o: Made at initial recognition and irrevocable per instrument
questions.why: The other-OCI election is made on initial recognition, instrument by instrument, irrevocably.
questions.trend: Core concept that appears in some avatar in most attempts under the new scheme (pattern estimate).

mem.tip: Sign once, per share class — no annual change of heart.

questions.q: A financial guarantee issued by the entity (not insurance-specific) is measured:
o: Under Ind AS 37 provision rules only
Initially at FV; thereafter higher of ECL (109) and the amount under Ind AS 37
questions.why: FBC: initially fair value, then the higher of ECL allowance and the amount recognised (Ind AS 37) — a dual-lens standard.
questions.trend: Known trap zone: ICAI objective papers repeatedly test limits/exceptions of this rule (pattern estimate).
questions.probWhy: Realistic likelihood for Nov 2026 — the higher-of-after pair is a known format AI prediction, not a certainty.

mem.tip: Guarantees age like fine wine and insurance: take whichever liability looks bigger.
mem.link: Chapter 9 — Accounting and Reporting of Financial Instruments

questions.q: The hedged item in a hedge of a net investment in a foreign operation is:
o: The net assets of the foreign operation (against FX risk)
questions.why: Net-investment hedge: exposure to FX risk of net assets of a foreign operation; effective portion to OCI (CTDR side), like cash-flow hedges.

questions.probWhy: Realistic likelihood for Nov 2026 — hedge-type matching one-liner AI prediction, not a certainty.

mem.tip: You hedge the stake you hold abroad; the reserve is the currency's diary.

questions.why: Ind AS 109 policy choice for regular-way purchases; derecognition of financial assets uses derecognition tests; equity securities may use trade or settlement accounting consistently.

questions.q: Vertex Ltd irrevocably elected FVOCI for a strategic equity investment bought at Rs 480 lakh; it stood at Rs 530 lakh last year-end and was sold this year for Rs 544 lakh. On disposal, P&L shows:
o: P&L gain nil; entire Rs 64 lakh gain stays in OCI/equity
questions.why: The FVOCI equity election takes ALL gains/losses to OCI permanently; on sale, the cumulative Rs 64 lakh is re-presented within equity (OCI → retained earnings) — no P&L recycling, unlike debt.
questions.trend: Known trap zone: ICAI objective papers repeatedly test limits/exceptions of this rule (pattern estimate).
questions.probWhy: Realistic likelihood for Nov 2026 — no-recycle-on-disposal for equity FVOCI is a recurring option trap AI prediction, not a certainty.

mem.tip: FVOCI equity (no-sale model election): all fair value moves to OCI; on sale, NO recycling to P&L — transfer within equity.
